answer: A lantern hung beside each cedar shell burns once per epoch, and its light reads the kernel sealed inside. Each identity seals one kernel at registration, backed by a 750,000 POA stake. Two kernels glowing the same pattern belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 350,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 1,100,000 POA, and five fakes cost 5,500,000 POA before any payout clears.
